steps.name: Fetch latest main
steps.command:
git -C /srv/myapp/source fetch origin main
git -C /srv/myapp/source checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
git -C /srv/myapp/source log -1 --format=%h

steps.name: Test and build candidate
steps.command:
cd /srv/myapp/source
go test ./...
install -d /srv/myapp/bin
go build -o /srv/myapp/bin/myapp.next ./cmd/myapp

steps.name: Check application health
steps.command:
for attempt in {1..10}; do
    if code=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 2 --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz) && [[ $code == 2[0-9][0-9] ]]; then
        printf 'Application health check passed\n'
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 2
done
printf 'Health check failed after 10 attempts\n' >&2
exit 1
